Commentary.Commentary: AB de Villiers was still out there and he found an able partner in Farhaan Behardien. Both the batsmen were slow to take off but after surviving some scares, went berserk towards the end. They scored 58 runs in the last 6 overs and helped the team get past the 140-run mark. The total still seems below par but the pitch is turning and the visitors have two wrist spinners in their ranks. Join us for the chase soon, which looks to be an interesting one.

An unbeaten 110-run stand for the 4th wicket has helped the Proteas post a fighting total. The English pacers started off in a dream fashion. Both the new ball bowlers, David Willey and Mark Wood, took wickets off their first deliveries. David Miller also fell soon to Wood. The spin duo of Liam Dawson and Mason Crane then kept things tight for the home side.
Fuller length ball outside off, Behardien drives it through the covers and takes a single. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 142/3!
Drags his length back and hits the deck hard, de Villiers makes room and lofts it over cover-point. Can't beat the sweeper though so only a single.
Very full from Jordan, AB de Villiers miscues his lofted shot to the left of wide long on. It's hit quite straight which allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Fuller and attacking the stumps, driven back down the track for nothing.

SIX! When he's on song, there's nobody better. A scintillating shot from the superb player. Walks across to this and takes it on the full. Gets low and slog sweeps it over backward square leg for half a dozen.
100-run stand up between AB de Villiers and Farhaan Behardien.
Low full toss and it's driven through the covers for a run.
Short again, de Villiers looks to play the uppercut but is undone by the pace on it.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Short this time, Behardien pulls it over mid-wicket. Deep square leg comes running in to his left to try and take it but it falls well short of him. A couple of runs are taken.

SIX! Stand and deliver stuff from Farhaan Behardien! That's a shot from a man possessing tremendous confidence. He walks down the track and with a perfectly straight bat lofts it back down the ground for a maximum. As elegant as you'd like. Super shot.
Maiden T20I fifty for Farhaan Behardien!

FOUR! Fifty for Farhaan! He's been very good since he's walked out to bat. Good way to bring up the milestone as well. He pulls it away with power to send it across the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.

Shortish delivery outside off, Behardien backs away and cuts it through point. Billings out at sweeper cover runs to his left and puts in a dive to keep it from the rope. Great effort, he had to cover a lot of ground. Keeps the batsmen to just two.
Mark Wood to bowl the penultimate over.
This full ball is off driven. Roy at mid off, dives to his right and stops a certain boundary. A single is taken. What an over, this. Just 4 from it.
High full toss on off, Farhaan misses out on the freebie. Miscues it in front of the extra cover fielder, who's right at the edge of the circle.
Almost a yorker, angling back in on middle and leg, de Villiers does well to get his front leg out of the way and whip it to long on for a single.
Very full just around off, drilled a bit square towards cover-point for a run.
Seaming in on the hips, tucked through backward square leg for one run.
That's an excellent delivery. Good start to the over from Jordan. Seeing AB back away, he fires it full and wide outside off, the stand-in Protea skipper can't do much about it.
Chris Jordan to bowl his last spell.
Back of a length, AB clears his front leg and muscles it down to long on for a single.
10th T20I fifty for AB de Villiers!

SIX! There it is! That's an AB de Villiers special. He's premeditated this, walks across to this fuller ball and scoops it over short fine leg. Hits that so well that it travels all the way for a maximum.

On the shorter side of things, pulled over square leg this time. It's in the air for quite a while as Crane out in the deep runs in. Doesn't judge it well and eventually, the ball falls short of him. One run taken.

OUCH! Can't even imagine how much that must have stung. Real ripper from Willey, on a back of a length and it's zipping through. Behardien looks to pull it away but is hit on the abdomen after getting an inside edge on it. He's instantly down on the ground.

Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, de Villiers tries to clobber it over long on but isn't in control of this shot at all. His bottom hand comes off as he plays it aerially in the same region. Just a single.
Moving away from around off, plays away from his body as he punches it to covers for a quick one.
Coming back in on a length, Behardien makes room and cracks it through the covers to retain strike.
SIX! HE'S NAILED THAT! Wood pounds it in short and Behardien picks up the length really early. He rocks backs, swivels and pulls it with all his might over backward square leg for a biggie.
Short of a good length on middle and leg, tad slower in pace which is probably what makes Farhaan miss his ramp shot.
Comes from wide of the crease and angles in a low full toss just outside off, AB moves across and drives it down to long on for a single.
Short ball angling back in, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Good length delivery on off, angling in, it's played back down the track to the left of the bowler.
Mark Wood comes back on.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Full and angling down, de Villiers makes room and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Going for the big one, Farhaan skips down the track and swings his bat, only to get an inside edge behind to the keeper. It falls just short of him and lobs off him on the leg side. Single taken.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Poor positioning from the debutant Crane. Willey bangs this in short as Behardien pulls it over square leg. It's flying to Crane out in the deep, who has walked in a few paces. He then has to pedal back and as a result, he loses the ball. It brushes off his fingertips and falls just inside the rope, before it goes across it.
Length delivery going across, Behardien makes room and punches it straight to mid off.
Just back of a length on middle and off, shaping back in a shade, Behardien tucks it square on the leg side and takes two runs quickly. Good running.
David Willey is back into the attack.
FOUR! Full toss and put away! Finally de Villiers gets one away. Pulls the high full toss in the cow corner. Bisects the deep mid-wicket and the long on fielder for a boundary.
Crane bowls it in the blockhole, de Villiers only manages to dig it out back to the bowler.
Punched through covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, played to extra cover.

In the air... but falls safe! Leg spinner on the shorter side. De Villiers clears his front leg and looks to pull it over mid-wicket, gets a top edge and the ball balloons high in the mid off region. Roy at extra cover, tries catching it by running towards the ball but fails to get to it. A single is taken and that is a reprieve for AB.
Looped up nicely outside off, driven straight to extra cover.
Straighter one, punched to Roy at cover. Dawson finishes with 4-0-17-0!
Once again de Villiers makes room and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Behardien dances down the track, looks to go big downtown but gets it off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
De Villiers makes room for himself, Dawson cleverly follows him. The Protea skipper goes for the slog sweep but gets it off the inside edge to deep backward square leg for a single.
Full on off, driven in the cover region. Roy inside the circle makes a good, diving stop. No run taken.
Served shorter outside off, spinning away, AB cuts it through point and picks up a couple.

Slider, angling down leg. Behardien backs away, looks to play across the line but misses and is rapped on the pads. There's an appeal from the English players but it's rightly turned down as it was going down the leg side.
Another googly, flicked through wide mid on for a single.
Googly on the shorter side, de Villiers clears his front leg and hits it in the cow corner for a brace.
Loopy on middle, Behardien drives it to long off for a single.
Tossed up nicely around off, AB jams it down through mid on for a single.
Full and served in the line of the stumps, driven to covers.
Loopy full toss on the stumps, driven down to long on for an easy single. He'll retain strike with that.
Wrists this through the mid-wicket area and crosses over.
Shortens the length on this occasion, pulls it along the ground to deep mid-wicket for one.
Quicker through the air on off, de Villiers lunges forward in defense.
Full and outside off, driven through the big gap in the covers for a couple of runs.

Darted full on middle and leg, Behardien walks down the track, clips it down to short fine leg and sets off. Dangerous run as it's straight to the fielder, who has a shy at the striker's end but it just misses. AB would have been gone had that hit, real close call.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Wrong one, drilled hard to long on for a single.
Full outside off, milked down to long off for a single.
Googly, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Tossed up outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Behardien works it down the leg side for a single.
Beaten! Served around off, spins away with extra bounce. De Villiers looks to punch it off the back foot but gets beaten by the bounce.
Once again it falls short! De Villiers backs away and punches it straight down. It's played uppishly again but once again to his luck it falls just before Dawson.
Just short! Full outside off, de Villiers drives it uppishly but is lucky that the ball falls just short of Roy at covers.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut through cover-point for a single.
Arm ball, punched back to the bowler.
Full outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Edgy! Leg spinner on the shorter side, Farhaan backs away, looks to cut it on the off side but gets a thick outside edge. The ball races past short third man and away to the fence for a boundary.
Googly around off, Farhaan makes room and works it to short third man.

Big shout for lbw! Turned down, however. The leggie starts off with a leg-spinner around leg, Farhaan fails to pick it up, clears his front leg and looks to punch it on the leg side but is beaten. Gets rapped on the pads and players start appealing but it's turned down. Height might be the reason.
The debutant Mason Crane comes on to bowl.
Farhaan dances down the track and pushes down the track on the off side for a single.
Served on the shorter side, AB makes room and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Full and sliding in, driven to long on for a single.
Sliding into the batsman, defended on the leg side.
Full around off, eased down to long off for a single.
De Villiers makes room and drives it to short cover.
Liam Dawson replaces Wood.
Angling into the batsman, worked to deep square leg for a single. End of a good Powerplay for England!

Slower one outside off, pushed on the off side. Dawson comes across from extra cover but misfields and the batsmen run through for a single. Billings from mid off hurls a wild throw at the keeper's end but is lucky that the short fine leg fielder does good back-up work.
Wide outside off, cut through backward point for a brace.
Short delivery around off, pulled in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Angling into the batsman, played through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! That will boost his confidence. Short outside off, Behardien glides it past first slip. Beats the third man fielder as well for his first boundary.
Banged in short, AB ducks to evade it.
Pitched outside off, driven to mid off.
Short and angling in, FB mistimes his pull to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Farhaan looks to play it across the line but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Absolute jaffa! Banged in short outside off, takes Behardien by surprise. However, he does well to fend it away.
Farhaan Behardien is the new man in.

OUT! Miller departs! Good length delivery around off, nips in a touch. Miller hops, looking to play but is undone by the movement off the seam. Gets a faint bottom edge and Buttler takes a good, low catch to complete the proceedings. Mark Wood is continuing his good work from the Champions Trophy. South Africa in trouble now.
Mark Wood will have a change of ends.
FOUR! Finally de Villiers connects! Full outside off, AB with a forward stride lofts it over mid off. The ball goes on the bounce across the ropes.
Beaten! Slower one almost does AB in! He makes room and tries to go hard at it but gets beaten by the slower one.

Back of a length delivery, angling in, de Villiers looks to work it across the line but is late in bringing his bat down. Gets rapped on the thigh pad and then the ball lobs off the gloves on the pitch.
De Villiers makes room, looks to slam the length delivery but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Short delivery, angling away, Miller hops and dabs it beside the track for a run.
On a length outside off, glided past slip, down to third man for a single.
Chris Jordan is the first change.
Pitched outside off, defended to covers.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Third man comes inside the circle, mid on drops back.
Full inswinger outside off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Miller shimmies a touch and flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

SIX! Just a short-arm jab! Length delivery outside off, Miller steps down the track and lofts it over mid off. The timing is so good on it that the ball sails over the fence for a maximum. 16 runs from the last 5 deliveries.

FOUR! This will ease off the pressure! Slightly shorter in length outside off, de Villiers clears his front leg and slaps it wide of mid off to collect his second boundary. Good comeback from the Proteas in the over.
Angling into the pads, tucked behind square leg for a brace.
A touch ahead of length outside off, defended in the cover region.
FOUR! First boundary of the day! Back of a length delivery outside off, de Villiers hops a touch and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Miller dabs it behind square on the off side and gets off the mark with a single.
David Miller walks out to bat. It's his 50th T20I and his team is in need of experience out in the middle.

OUT! Wood starts in similar fashion to Willey! Gets rid of the other Protea opener. He pitches it short around off, Hendricks looks to go after it. Fails to control his pull and finds Willey at mid-wicket, who jumps and takes a good, sharp catch. What a start this for the home side! They have sent both the openers back in the hut.
Mark Wood to share the new ball. Two slips in place for him!
Full around off, de Villiers comes ahead a touch and pushes it to mid off.
Full and swinging in, driven to mid on.
Half-volley on middle, de Villiers clips it with ease through mid-wicket. A man is present in the deep there and only a couple taken. Good field placement, this!
Back of a length delivery around off, Reeza stands tall and punches it through extra cover. Jordan from mid off chases it down and sweeps it in before the fence. Saves a run for his team.
Straying on the pads once again, worked on the leg side for a single.
Wide! Willey gets his line wrong this time, bowls it down the leg side and a wide is signaled.
AB de Villiers is the new man in.

OUT! Perfect start for England! David Willey the provider! He starts off with a superb delivery, bowls it full outside off. Gets it to swing back in. Smuts prods forward to push it on the off side but the inward movement does him in. Catches an inside edge, onto the pads and then deflects onto the stumps. Smuts bags a golden duck.

The players and the umpires have made their way out in the middle. JJ Smuts and Reeza Hendricks to open for South Africa. David Willey to start the proceedings with the new ball. He has a slip in place. It's bright and sunny out there, perfect conditions to play. Here we go...
ENGLAND XI - Jason Roy, Alex Hales, Jonny Bairstow, Eoin Morgan (c), Jos Buttler (wk), Sam Billings, Liam Dawson, Mason Crane, David Willey, Chris Jordan, Mark Wood.

SOUTH AFRICA XI - JJ Smuts, Reeza Hendricks, AB de Villiers (c), David Miller, Farhaan Behardien, Mangaliso Mosehle (wk), Wayne Parnell, Dwaine Pretorius, Andile Phehlukwayo, Tabraiz Shamsi, Imran Tahir.

TOSS - SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT. Mason Crane makes his international debut while Dwaine Pretorius and Tarbaiz Shamsi make their T20I debuts. Also, David Miller will be playing his 50th T20I.

Key players will be rested on both sides, so some fresh/young faces will feature in this series. With the hungry wanting to stake a claim in the XI, and the Englishmen and the Proteas having a disappointing outing in the Champions Trophy for different reasons, you can be sure we're in for some fierce contests.

After a big tournament like the Champions Trophy comes to an end, the only remedy to satisfy a longing heart is some more cricketing action. And what better than two quality sides battling it out in the most explosive format of the game. Welcome, folks, as England and South Africa go at it at The Rose Bowl for the first of the 3-match T20I series.
